text_block_list.text: One morning, at the school-wide assembly—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Certificate of Commendation! To Sakura 
Chiyono O! You have led your life this 
month as the most exemplary model for all 
students!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, I greeted everyone properly 
every morning, was never late, stayed 
focused in class, and never forgot my 
things even once!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I present to you this month's 
Disciplinary Committee Chairman's Award! 
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Let's continue to uphold public morals 
together as role models for everyone!"
(Clap clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehehe. It really feels nice being 
praised. It gets me all fired up, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san is counting on me too! I 
definitely want to protect the academy's 
public morals!
(*WHAM!*)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah?! An explosion?! Wait... there's smoke 
coming from the classroom~?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Heyyy! Hold on right there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, you arrived sooner than I 
thought! However, I wonder if you can 
actually catch me!?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh! They totally got the better of me 
last time... Can I really catch them all 
on my own...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is...! As this month's recipient 
of the Disciplinary Committee Chairman's 
Award, isn't this my time to shine!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even so, how am I supposed to help...! 
Ummm, let's see...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's just go for it!

Alright, let's flank around and pincer 
them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: P-P-P-Pounce on them!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, but as this month's Disciplinary 
Committee Chairman Award recipient, I know 
I can do this! Yes I can, yes I can...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa~!?

Thanks to Sakura Chiyono O's desperate 
tackle, Agnes Tachyon was successfully 
apprehended.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As expected of this month's Disciplinary 
Committee Head Award winner! Nice one~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Tachyon! Today's the day you're 
writing a full apology letter, no excuses!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright! I'll give in for today. 
I'll even write the reflection essay.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: “—And... ...Oh? What's that...?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Which one is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look at the sky, isn't there something 
shining up above?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~? I don't see anything like that 
though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be that over there? That 
shiny-looking thing, um...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...By that, you probably mean this light 
reflecting off the window, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! Ahaha, sorry about 
that~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Gasp!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: D-Dang it! They got me again-ssu~!

Even after falling for its tricks several 
more times... we somehow managed to catch 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-A pincer attack!? On Tachyon-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, but as this month's Disciplinary 
Committee Chairman Award recipient, I know 
I can do this! Yes I can, yes I can...!

And so, the two of us chased after Agnes 
Tachyon――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-You're not getting past me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, an unexpected assassin appears!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Chiyonoo, thank you very much! Today's the 
day, I give up~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
F-Finally cornered you! Tachyon-san, you 
can't run away anymore!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, calm down! I'll put on some tea, 
so let's talk this over first, shall we?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Dialogue is crucial in all matters. It 
might simply be a misunderstanding on your 
part. It wouldn't do for the Disciplinary 
Committee Head to pin a false accusation 
on someone, would it?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, th-that... That might actually be 
true...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A wise decision. Now then, please wait 
here while I fetch the tea leaves.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true, understanding is 
important! Apprehending people isn't the 
only job of the Disciplinary Committee, 
after all!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's sit down properly today and have a 
good talk with Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, Tachyon-san sure is taking a 
while. I wonder if she can't find the 
tea?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...... Wait, aren't they super late?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Indeed... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Aah!

Afterward, the academy became lively once 
again... and it wasn't until dusk that 
they were finally caught.
